original.reason: It incorrectly infers equality of the two arguments from equality of their f-values. All subsequent identities and the claimed injectivity therefore lack justification; moreover, non-injectivity does not imply constancy.

judgment.reason: The central “translation-chase lemma” is only asserted. The described substitutions neither specify valid chains nor prove that arguments coincide while retaining distinct values.

Its lemma is precisely the needed result but is not proved. The stated repeated application does not establish the displayed fixed value, nor that the interchanged calculation concerns the same point.
The alleged successive applications and chain interchange are unsupported. The claimed meeting of chains is undefined and unproved, so the conclusion that f is constant does not follow.
It invokes an unproved “standard translation-chase lemma.” Surjectivity supplies preimages, but the response gives no valid finite substitution sequence showing the relevant arguments coincide.
